title: 第1章 重生第2章 混沌造化诀
content_zh:
“江凡，江凡。”
听着耳边呼唤声，江凡身体微微颤动，一阵剧烈的疼痛瞬间袭来，伴随着阵阵发麻，仿佛被一座大山压住，令身体无法动弹。
用力睁开双眼，江凡茫然看向周围围观的人群，只见众人穿着是从未见过的五颜六色奇装异服，而且头发染的同样是五颜六色，奇怪的发型令人不忍直视。
我爱你，就像老鼠爱大米，，，听着奇怪歌曲，江凡一脸懵逼望向周边的高楼大厦，又看向路上疾速行驶的奇怪法宝，不由得更加茫然，自己这是来到了什么地方？
江凡大概能听的懂奇怪的歌曲，也听得懂周边人的语言，可周边人的语言明显不是自己所使用的语言，难道这里已不是苍玄大陆？
见江凡茫然的样子，周围众人暗暗咋舌，纷纷竖起大拇指，一副崇拜、佩服、震惊的模样，一时间江凡也不敢出声询问，只能暗暗戒备，防止有人对他出手偷袭。
“江凡，你怎么样，没事吧？”
看了眼一副紧张模样，关心询问自己的年轻人，江凡轻轻摇头，不敢发声，年轻人明显是他的朋友，可他却从未见过眼前的年轻人。
江凡内心一阵茫然，他出生于浩瀚无边的苍玄大陆，自幼进入三品宗门草木门修炼，修炼天赋算不上惊艳，也远超寻常修士，六十多岁便修炼到筑基巅峰，还是一位天资卓越的炼丹师和炼器师。
雪域每十年会举办一次非常隆重的炼丹师大会，草木门有两个珍贵名额，由于乘坐传送阵费用非常高昂，江凡同小师妹也就两人单独前往，可在乘坐传送阵期间，空间通道突然出现坍塌，好像是多个大能争夺什么东西，破碎虚空意外碰上了传送阵空间通道。
江凡茫然看向四周，虚空破碎引发空间乱流，他当时同小师妹紧紧抱在一起，他来到这个不知名的大陆，可怎么不见小师妹的身影。
紧皱眉头，轰，一声巨响在脑海中轰鸣，一阵阵剧烈头疼再次传来，紧接着，乱七八糟信息瞬间充斥脑海。
这个大陆叫地球，一个下位面低等星球，普通人对修真之事几乎闻所未闻，科技非常盛行，而这具身体的主人也叫江凡，燕京五大家族之一的秦家弃子！
身体主人有着很狗血的身世，母亲江诗雅是苏州人士，七十年代末以优异成绩考上华夏最高学府燕京大学，响应举国之力建设宝钢的时代号召，报考外国语学院的日语专业。
江南水乡多美女，江诗雅在外国语学院犹如女神般的存在，追求者如过江之鲫，农村来的小姑娘没有见过什么大世面，没禁住死皮赖脸秦经伦的糖衣炮弹，两人也就坠入爱河。
门户之见根深蒂固，世家子弟联姻肯定要门当户对，即使秦经伦动用生米煮成熟饭、以死相逼的烂招，依然无法弥补两人身份上的差距，不得不接受棒打鸳鸯的残酷现实。
秦家怎么说也是燕京五大家族之一，事情做的不地道，还是要脸面的，待江诗雅生下龙凤胎之后，主动提出抚养小女儿，至于秦家嫡长子江凡，也只能沦为弃子。
江诗雅也是无奈之举，一人无力抚养两个孩子，女儿由秦家来抚养也不是坏事，不会卷入什么狗血的家主争夺，血浓于水，未来女儿也能在某些方面帮扶下江凡，背靠大树好乘凉。
江诗雅也是要强的女子，拒绝秦家帮忙在苏州或申城安排工作的好意，正好又赶上改革开放的浪潮，也就在苏申两地做起给工厂做日语翻译的工作，时不时去日本出差，混的也算是风生水起。
江山代有才人出，随着江凡不断长大，江诗雅也就放弃时常出差的翻译工作，为了更好照顾和教育江凡，也就在苏州做起经营日本料理的生意。

江凡也算争气，去年高考以优异成绩考上金陵的华夏药科大学，报考的是食品营养与健康专业，未来也能更好发扬光大自家餐厅，不幸的是，分数不够，被调剂到中药学院下的中药学专业。
也不算糟糕，用江母的话，中医越老越吃香，未来药膳养生有着广泛市场前景，不会像外语专业被时代抛弃。
前年华夏成功加入WTO，越来越多日本企业前往苏州设厂，一直小打小闹的江诗雅也不想被秦家人看不起，斥资百万，又从银行贷款六十万，在苏州盘下三层楼的店面，走高端日本料理的路线。
耗时半年多的豪华装修，没迎来餐厅开业，却迎来肆虐全球的流感，餐厅长时间停业，房租、人工、利息是一笔沉重的开支，压的江诗雅喘不过气来，更糟糕的是，江诗雅四处奔波期间感染上流感，没等到餐厅开业，便不幸撒手人寰。
江母的离世给江凡带来晴天霹雳的打击，也留下一个大烂摊子，流感依然肆虐，店铺依然未能营业，还欠着银行六十多万贷款和利息，没什么管理经验的江凡，也不能辍学去经营餐厅，何况什么时候可以营业是个未解之谜。
秦家挺厚道，派申城的家族子弟到苏州帮忙处理后事，主动提出帮忙偿还银行贷款和买下店铺的产业，且保证负责江凡读大学生活开销以及结婚买房事宜。
可前身江凡是个死脑筋，对秦经伦以及秦家一直耿耿于怀，谢绝秦家的帮助，不过还是在秦家的帮助下，卖掉苏州的四合院，低价转让装修好未营业的餐厅，偿还掉银行的债务和拖欠员工的工资。
怎么说呢，人争一口气，佛争一炷香，江母耿直要强一辈子，前身江凡要是答应秦家的帮助，那江母恐怕会死不瞑目，江凡在秦家面前一辈子也抬不起头。
处理完江母后事和店铺事宜，江凡刚回到学校，同班好友木志乐邀请他到玄武湖公园喝酒，也是想着借酒消愁，开解江凡一番，生活总是要继续的嘛。
哪曾想，两人拎着白酒和下酒菜刚来到玄武湖公园，晴朗的天空中突然响起雷声，一道雷电以迅雷不及掩耳速度正好击中前身，而江凡可能伴随着那道雷电魂穿这具身体。
感受着前身那股强大的怨气和戾气，放心吧，哥江凡以道心起誓，哥以后会好好照顾胞妹秦紫菱，过上公主般无忧无虑的幸福生活，也会让秦家以弱者姿态仰视哥的风采！
随着前身的灵魂被吞噬，彻底消失在天地间，江凡脑海瞬间一阵清明，以后地球上只有来自苍玄大陆的江凡，内心禁不住无奈叹息，哥可以帮你照顾胞妹，可哥的小师妹又在哪里？

content_en:
"Jiang Fan, Jiang Fan."
Listening to the call in his ear, Jiang Fan's body trembled slightly, and a sharp pain hit him instantly, accompanied by waves of numbness, as if he was being pressed by a mountain, making his body unable to move.
Opening his eyes with force, Jiang Fan looked blankly at the crowd of people around him. He saw that everyone was wearing colorful and strange clothes that he had never seen before, and their hair was also dyed in colorful colors. The strange hairstyle was unbearable to look at.
I love you, just like a mouse loves rice. Listening to the strange song, Jiang Fan looked at the surrounding high-rise buildings in confusion, and then at the strange magic weapon speeding on the road. He couldn't help but feel even more confused. Where did he come?
Jiang Fan can probably listen to strange songs and understand the language of the people around him, but the language of the people around him is obviously not the language he uses. Is this not Cangxuan Continent anymore?
Seeing Jiang Fan's confused look, everyone around him was secretly speechless and gave thumbs up, showing admiration, admiration, and shock. For a moment, Jiang Fan did not dare to ask questions out loud, and could only secretly be on guard to prevent anyone from making a sneak attack on him.
"Jiang Fan, how are you, are you okay?"
Glancing at the young man who looked nervous and asked questions about him, Jiang Fan shook his head slightly and did not dare to speak. The young man was obviously his friend, but he had never seen the young man in front of him.
Jiang Fan was at a loss in his heart. He was born in the vast Cangxuan Continent. He entered the Caomu Sect of the third-grade sect to practice at an early age. His cultivation talent was not amazing, but it was far beyond ordinary monks. He reached the peak of foundation building in his sixties, and he was also an extremely talented alchemist and weapon refiner.
The Snowy Region holds a very grand alchemist conference every ten years. There are two precious places in Caomumen. Since riding the teleportation array is very expensive, Jiang Fan and his junior sister went there alone. However, during the ride on the teleportation array, the space passage suddenly collapsed, as if multiple powerful powers were fighting for something. Shattered Void accidentally ran into the teleportation array space passage.
Jiang Fan looked around blankly. The shattering of the void caused space turbulence. He and his junior sister were hugging each other tightly. He came to this unknown continent, but he could not see his junior sister.
He frowned, and boom, a loud noise roared in his mind, and waves of severe headaches came again, and then, messy information instantly filled his mind.
This continent is called Earth, a low-level planet in the lower plane. Ordinary people have almost never heard of cultivation. Technology is very popular. The owner of this body is also named Jiang Fan, an abandoned son of the Qin family, one of the five major families in Yanjing!
The owner of the body has a very ugly life experience. His mother, Jiang Shiya, is from Suzhou. In the late 1970s, she was admitted to Yenching University, the highest university in China, with excellent results. In response to the call of the times to build Baosteel with national efforts, she applied for the Japanese major at the School of Foreign Languages.
There are many beauties in the Jiangnan water town. Jiang Shiya is like a goddess in the School of Foreign Languages, and her pursuers are like crucian carp crossing the river. The little girl from the countryside has never seen much of the world, so she couldn't resist Qin Jinglun's sugar-coated bullets, and the two fell in love.
The family feud is deeply rooted, and children from aristocratic families must be well-matched when marrying. Even if Qin Jinglun uses raw rice to cook cooked rice and threatens each other with death, he still cannot make up for the gap in status between the two, and he has to accept the cruel reality of beating mandarin ducks.
After all, the Qin family is one of the five major families in Yanjing. They do things in an unethical manner, but they still want to show face. After Jiang Shiya gave birth to twins, they offered to raise their little daughter. As for the eldest son of the Qin family, Jiang Fan, he could only become an abandoned son.
Jiang Shiya also had no choice but to raise two children. It would not be a bad thing for her daughter to be raised by the Qin family. She would not be involved in any bloody competition for the head of the family. Blood is thicker than water. In the future, her daughter could also help Jiang Fan in some aspects and rest against a big tree to enjoy the shade.
Jiang Shiya is also a strong woman and refused the Qin family's offer to help arrange work in Suzhou or Shanghai.Just in time to catch up with the wave of reform and opening up, I started working as a Japanese translator for factories in Suzhou and Shenzhen. I went to Japan for business trips from time to time, and I was doing well.
Talented people emerge from generation to generation. As Jiang Fan grew up, Jiang Shiya gave up her job as a translator who often traveled on business. In order to better take care of and educate Jiang Fan, she started a Japanese restaurant business in Suzhou.
Jiang Fan is also quite successful. He was admitted to the Huaxia Pharmaceutical University in Jinling with excellent results in the college entrance examination last year. He applied for the major of food nutrition and health, and he will be able to better develop his own restaurant in the future. Unfortunately, his score was not enough, so he was transferred to the major of traditional Chinese medicine under the School of Traditional Chinese Medicine.
It’s not too bad. In Jiang Mu’s words, traditional Chinese medicine becomes more and more popular with age. In the future, medicated diet and health care will have broad market prospects and will not be abandoned by the times like the foreign language major.
The year before last, China had successfully joined the WTO, and more and more Japanese companies were setting up factories in Suzhou. Jiang Shiya, who had always been working on a small business, did not want to be looked down upon by the Qin family, so she spent millions and borrowed another 600,000 from the bank to build a three-story store in Suzhou, serving high-end Japanese cuisine.
The luxurious decoration, which took more than half a year, did not usher in the opening of the restaurant, but instead ushered in the influenza that was raging around the world. The restaurant was closed for a long time. Rent, labor, and interest were a heavy expense, which made Jiang Shiya breathless. To make matters worse, Jiang Shiya contracted the flu while running around, and unfortunately passed away before the restaurant could open.
The death of Jiang's mother was a sudden blow to Jiang Fan, and left a huge mess. The flu was still raging, the shop was still closed, and he still owed more than 600,000 yuan in bank loans and interest. Jiang Fan, who had little management experience, could not drop out of school to run a restaurant, not to mention when he would be able to open for business was an unsolved mystery.
The Qin family was very kind and sent family members from Shencheng to Suzhou to help with the funeral arrangements. They offered to help repay the bank loan and buy the store property, and promised to take care of Jiang Fan's college living expenses and marriage and house purchase.
But the predecessor, Jiang Fan, was a hard-headed man who always cared about Qin Jinglun and the Qin family, and refused the Qin family's help. However, with the help of the Qin family, he sold the courtyard house in Suzhou, transferred and renovated the unopened restaurant at a low price, and paid off the bank's debts and arrears of wages to employees.
How can I put it, people fight for a breath, Buddha fights for a stick of incense, Jiang Mu is upright and will be strong all her life. If the predecessor Jiang Fan agreed to the Qin family's help, then Jiang Mu would probably die in peace, and Jiang Fan would never be able to hold his head up in front of the Qin family for the rest of his life.
After dealing with Jiang's mother's funeral and store matters, Jiang Fan had just returned to school. His classmate Mu Zhile invited him to have a drink in Xuanwu Lake Park. He also wanted to drink to relieve his worries and relax Jiang Fan. Life must go on.
Who would have thought that when the two of them arrived at Xuanwu Lake Park carrying liquor and snacks, thunder suddenly sounded in the clear sky, and a bolt of lightning hit the front of the body at lightning speed, and Jiang Fan might be accompanied by the thunder and lightning that penetrated this body.
Feeling the strong resentment and hostility of my predecessor, don't worry, brother Jiang Fan swears with his Taoist heart that he will take good care of his sister Qin Ziling in the future, live a carefree and happy life like a princess, and make the Qin family look up to him as a weakling!
As the soul of his predecessor was swallowed up and completely disappeared between heaven and earth, Jiang Fan's mind suddenly became clear. From now on, Jiang Fan from Cangxuan Continent will be the only one on earth. He couldn't help but sigh helplessly in his heart. I can help you take care of my sister, but where is my junior sister?
